Leo (Eng Manager): Hey team — quick edge case. We're promoting Mei (UK, on a Skilled Worker visa) mid-cycle from IC3 -> IC4 and bumping comp + RSU. Any immigration or payroll pitfalls I should know about?
Priya (People Ops): Hi Leo! Short: promotion itself doesn't usually affect visa status, but salary bumps can trigger sponsor duties if new salary crosses SOC codes or sponsor thresholds. Loop in Immigration + Payroll.
Helena (Immigration): Hi all. Confirming: if salary increase moves them above the visas listed occupation code threshold, we must notify UKVI and update the sponsorship record. Small increases inside the same SOC band are fine; big jumps (or role changes that change SOC) need filing. Please share exact new base.

Leo (Eng Manager): Ugh paste glitches. New base = 
Priya (People Ops): Leo, small note: avoid pasting currency symbols that might get eaten. Can you re-send new base in GBP?
Leo (Eng Manager): New base = GBP 98,000 (current GBP 85,000). RSU: pro-rated 0.05% grant. Effective_date requested = 2026-03-20.
Helena (Immigration): Thanks. That ~15% bump likely stays in same SOC code, but I need to check sponsor certificate details. If we update the sponsor, its an administrative step — no visa reissue necessary, but we must record the change and notify the employee.
Luis (Payroll): For UK runs: payroll cutoff is 4 business days before pay date. If approvals are in after cutoff we can do retro pay in next run or do an off-cycle with Finance signoff. Also SR tax code and pension auto-enrolment contributions could be impacted by base changes.
Anita (Finance): Off-cycle fees apply for manual runs. Also, if Immigration requires an internal amendment, theres a small admin cost we charge to the hiring team. Please include cost center for approval.
Priya (People Ops): Steps for you, Leo: 1) Submit leveling packet with manager justification & performance bullets. 2) Mark "visa_affects_sponsor" = yes (so Immigration reviews). 3) Attach RSU request if you want equity processed in parallel. 4) Confirm effective_date and whether manager will announce pre-approval (dont).
Leo (Eng Manager): Will submit. One more: does promotion during visa sponsorship affect probation, benefits waiting periods, or equity vesting?
Helena (Immigration): Nothing specific for probation — employment terms remain. But if role change includes managerial duties that alter certificate wording, we note it. Equity/legal acceptance forms must be signed; no visa-specific blocker.
Luis (Payroll): Vesting: equity grant date can match effective_date but tax treatment on RSUs depends on UK TAX YEAR and employee residency. Also pension contributions (%) may change with higher base — check auto-enrolment thresholds.
Anita (Finance): If the RSU grant exceeds local reporting thresholds we need payroll to do PAYE/withholding on award or apply net settlement; we'll coordinate with EquityOps. Add a note in the packet if pro-rated RSU > 
Priya (People Ops): FYI manager communications: dont share final numbers until comp committee and immigration signoff if sponsor update required. You can say "promotion under review; ETA 3-5 business days."
Leo (Eng Manager): Submitted leveling packet + RSU request, marked visa_affects_sponsor. Added cost center ENG-UK-04.
Priya (People Ops): Received. Routing to leveling committee + Immigration review. ETA leveling 1-2 business days; Immigration ETA 2 business days.
Helena (Immigration): Checked sponsor: salary threshold not crossed for the SOC reference. No UKVI notification required. I'll still update our internal sponsor record.
Luis (Payroll): Leveling approved?
Priya (People Ops): Leveling committee approved the level change. Passing to comp committee for >10% increase.
Anita (Finance): Comp committee approved base GBP 98k and pro-rated RSU. Anita -> will route cost approvals.
Luis (Payroll): I'll watch the payroll cutoff. If approvals land after cutoff we will process retro adjustment in next run. If you want payroll to try an off-cycle, confirm to me and Finance (fees apply).
Leo (Eng Manager): Thanks all. Communicated to Mei per guidance: "approved pending final paperwork".
Priya (People Ops): Final admin: People Ops will send official comp letter and updated HRIS job profile. Immigration will confirm sponsor record update. Closing thread once letters sent. :white_check_mark:
